description: Small metadata-only public-domain-style story inventory fixture for Assistant OS v0.1.

items.title: Moon Drum Walk
items.summary: A child follows a talking drum through a rainy city and learns to listen before acting.
items.narrative_frame: {name} found a talking drum in {location}. The drum taught {name} to share, listen, and come home before the rain.

items.title: The Tortoise Who Asked First
items.summary: A small tortoise solves large problems by asking careful questions.
items.narrative_frame: {name} met a tiny tortoise who solved big problems by asking good questions before rushing.

items.title: The Rain Map
items.summary: A bedtime map appears during the rain and rewards careful listening.
items.narrative_frame: When the rain tapped the roof in {location}, {name} found a map that only appeared after bedtime prayers and careful listening.

items.title: The Star School
items.summary: A child discovers that stars can be studied patiently from a schoolyard.
items.narrative_frame: At school, {name} noticed one bright star before sunset and learned that curiosity grows when questions are written down.
